messages:
andrea: Starting canary push for svc-search at 23:00 UTC in the night window. Target 10% traffic. Need confirmation on who will press and whether we can grant temporary MFA exception for contractor coverage.

sam: Who's on-call for deploys? I thought kevin was off tonight.

andrea: Kevin said he could cover until 22:45, but the window is 23:00. Need a named presser or ops handoff.

kevin: I'm available until 22:45 UTC then unreachable. I can handoff if needed.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall here. We can cover the 23:00 window but we need a named identity to press. Temporary exception requires 2 approvals per policy.

andrea: policy link https://internal.redwood/policies/deploy-access - asks for MFA + manager signoff. Contractor (mike-c) lost KMS MFA token.

maria: mike-c's access expired yesterday, security notified. Can we do a breakglass for this push? We only need press for canary, not full rollout.

emma-security: Security: we prefer using a staffed Redwood engineer. Exception path: 1) manager ack, 2) ops-oncall ack, 3) ticket logged. No permanent token changes. I'll approve if ops ok.

sam: @ops-oncall can you approve ops ack? Also, who will act as the named presser? @kevin?

kevin: I can press canary and monitor for the first 15m. If it's flat I can handover to mike-c for followups once he gets MFA back.

ops-oncall: Acked. We'll stand by, andrea please open ticket with tags: prod, temp-mfa, deploy. Include timebox: 23:00-23:30.

andrea: opened ticket PROD-4128 with details and included emma-security and ops-oncall. Link: https://tickets/redwood/PROD-4128

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: svc-search v3.2.1 -> 10% traffic. Monitoring: latency, error-rate.

sre-lead: quick note: pin v3.2.0 in case we need to rollback quickly. Keep watch on p99 latency.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary alert at +6m: error-rate spike 4.3% (baseline 0.2%).

andrea: aborting canary, rolling back to v3.2.0. @kevin please press rollback now.

kevin: pressing rollback: `deploy rollback svc-search --to v3.2.0` :hourglass: 

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Estimated completion 90s.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback successful. svc-search back on v3.2.0. Canary marked failed.

maria: thanks all. Reopening ticket with postmortem checklist. Security will follow up on mike-c MFA re-enrollment tomorrow.

emma-security: noted. No exception granted. We'll help schedule KMS MFA reset with identity team.

andrea: tl;dr: canary failed due to increased errors; rollback executed by kevin; ops stood by; no MFA exception granted; ticket created for follow-up.

sam: thanks. Let's reschedule canary for tomorrow morning with full on-call coverage.

ops-oncall: +1. Will coordinate.

kevin: +1. Good catch.
